FORM write_legend .

  write at vline1 sy-vline as line.
  write at vline2 'Inhalt'(024).
  write at vline3 sy-vline as line.
  write at 86 'Hilfe'(042).
  new-line.
  write at 2(90) sy-uline as line.
  new-line.

  loop at cp200_it_fieldcat into cp200_wa_fieldcat
        where fieldname <> 'MODTIME'.
    clear message_id.
    write  at 2 cp200_wa_fieldcat-coltext.

        write at vline1 sy-vline.
        write at vline2 'gelb:'(048)

        write at vline3 sy-vline as line.

      when 'STATUS'.

        write at vline3 sy-vline as line.
        write at 87 icon_system_help as icon hotspot.
        message_id = '407'.
        hide: message_id.
        new-line.
        write at vline1 sy-vline.
        write: at vline2 '  ',

        new-line.
        write at vline1 sy-vline.
        write: at vline2 icon_led_green as icon,

        write at vline1 sy-vline.

FORM get_descr_and_keylng
  using    tablename       type scpr_tabl
           tabledescr      type scpr_descs
  changing linkkeylng      type i
           tab_tabledescr  type scpr_descs
           link_tabledescr type scpr_descs
           rc              like sy-subrc.

  rc = 0.
  read table g_linkdescrs into g_linkdescr
                              with table key tablename = tablename.
  if sy-subrc = 0.
* get table descriptions from global data
    linkkeylng = g_linkdescr-keylng.
    tab_tabledescr = g_linkdescr-tab_tabledescr.
    link_tabledescr = g_linkdescr-link_tabledescr.
  else.
* calculate global table descriptions
    clear: g_position, g_link_flddescr, linkkeylng.
    refresh: tab_tabledescr.
    append lines of tabledescr[] to tab_tabledescr.
    if not tab_tabledescr is initial.
      read table tab_tabledescr with key bastabname = ' '
                                    transporting no fields.
      if sy-subrc <> 0.
        loop at tab_tabledescr transporting no fields
                              where bastabname <> tablename.
        endloop.
        if sy-subrc = 0.
* descriptions of s-table inclusive descriptions of texttable
* -> get new descriptions of bastab only
          refresh: tab_tabledescr.
        endif.
      endif.
    endif.
    if tab_tabledescr is initial.
      CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_DB_TABLE_TABFLDDEF_GET'
        EXPORTING
          TABNAME             = tablename
        TABLES
          FIELDDESCR          = tab_tabledescr
        EXCEPTIONS
          TABLE_NOT_FOUND     = 1
          DDIF_INTERNAL_ERROR = 2
          OTHERS              = 3.
      IF SY-SUBRC <> 0.
        rc = 1.
      ENDIF.
    endif.
    sort tab_tabledescr by position.
    delete tab_tabledescr where keyflag is initial.
* calculate global table descriptions for actlinks
    loop at tab_tabledescr assigning <g_flddescr>.
      move <g_flddescr> to g_link_flddescr.
      g_link_flddescr-position = g_position.
      append g_link_flddescr to link_tabledescr.
      if <g_flddescr>-vtype = 'X' or <g_flddescr>-vtype = 'I' or
         <g_flddescr>-vtype = 'F' or <g_flddescr>-vtype = 'P' or
         <g_flddescr>-vtype = 'b' or <g_flddescr>-vtype = 's'.
* rel. >= 610:  different coding in different releases   ************
        g_position = g_position +
          <g_flddescr>-outputlen * cl_abap_char_utilities=>charsize.
* rel. >= 610:  end of different coding in different releases   *****
      else.
        g_position = g_position + <g_flddescr>-intlen.
      endif.
    endloop.

FORM actlinks_get_recnumber
      changing it_scpractr_new type scpractrtab
               it_scpractr_del type scpractrtab.
* it_scpractr_new are the new links of the activation. these links must
* get proper tabrecnum-values.
* it_scpractr_del are the old links (from DB) which must be deleted due
* to the update process.


  sort it_scpractr_new by tablename viewname tabkey.
  clear: tablename_temp, tabrecnumbi.
  refresh: it_scpractr_del.

  loop at it_scpractr_new assigning <wa_scpractr_new>.
* read all links of table from DB into it_scpractr_old

      refresh: it_scpractr_old.
* rel.>46C  *** different coding in different releases   ************
      CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_HI_DB_SCPRACTR_READ'
        EXPORTING
          TABLENAME     = <wa_scpractr_new>-tablename
        IMPORTING
          ACTKEYS       = it_scpractr_old
        EXCEPTIONS
          NO_DATA_FOUND = 1
          OTHERS        = 2.
* rel.>46C  *** end of different coding in different releases   *****
      IF SY-SUBRC <> 0.
        refresh: it_scpractr_old.
        clear: tabrecnumbi.
      else.
        sort it_scpractr_old by tabrecnumb descending.
        read table it_scpractr_old index 1 assigning <wa_scpractr_temp>.
        move <wa_scpractr_temp>-tabrecnumb to tabrecnumbi.
      endif.
    endif.

* set new tabrecnumbers in new activation links (it_scpractr_new)
    tabrecnumbi = tabrecnumbi + 1.
    move tabrecnumbi to <wa_scpractr_new>-tabrecnumb.

* all old links of the same view and the same key must be deleted
    loop at it_scpractr_old assigning <wa_scpractr_old>
                    where tablename = <wa_scpractr_new>-tablename
                    and   viewname  = <wa_scpractr_new>-viewname
                    and   tabkey    = <wa_scpractr_new>-tabkey.
      append <wa_scpractr_old> to it_scpractr_del.
    endloop.

  endloop.


ENDFORM.                    " actlinks_get_recnumber

                         into cp200_recinfo transporting bcset.
        if not cp200_recinfo-bcset is initial.
          CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_CTRL_MN_MAINTAIN'
            EXPORTING
              BCSET_ID         = cp200_recinfo-bcset
              CATEGORY         = pcat_classic
            EXCEPTIONS
              BCSET_DONT_EXIST = 1
              OTHERS           = 2.
          IF SY-SUBRC <> 0.
            message i320.
          ENDIF.
        else.
          message i320.
        endif.

* click on date or time -> jump to activation protocol
      when 'ACTDATE' or 'ACTTIME'.
        clear cp200_recinfo.
        read table cp200_recinfos index es_row_no-row_id
            into cp200_recinfo transporting modifier actdate acttime.
        if not cp200_recinfo-acttime is initial
                        and not cp200_recinfo-actdate is initial
                        and not cp200_recinfo-modifier is initial.
          clear act_select.
          act_select-act_date = cp200_recinfo-actdate.
          act_select-act_time = cp200_recinfo-acttime.
          act_select-modifier = cp200_recinfo-modifier.
          CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_PR_MN_PROTOCOL'
            EXPORTING
              ACT_SELECT             = act_select
              category               = pcat_classic
            EXCEPTIONS
              NO_PROTOCOL            = 1
              WRONG_PARAMETERS       = 2
              OTHERS                 = 3.
          case sy-subrc.
            when 0.
            when 1.
              message i213.
            when 2.
              message i273.
            when others.
              message i320.
          endcase.
        endif.

      when others.
        message i320.
    endcase.

  endmethod.                    "on_hotspot_click
